name: zanker-motion-design
description: Design purposeful CSS/Motion/GSAP animation with reduced-motion equivalents.

workflow.instruction: Explain state change or spatial relationship communicated by motion.
Choose native CSS for simple transitions, framework library for interaction, advanced runtime only when justified.
Check Zanker motion presets `read ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/knowledge/media/motion-design.json`; generate tokens via `bash ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/motion-css.sh --out ...` if desired.
Test prefers-reduced-motion, focus behavior, exit timing and runtime performance.

fallback: Offer a static transition or simpler state feedback.
